name: clang-tidy
description: clang-tidy: LLVM's C and C++ linter, driven by a compilation database and the repository's .clang-tidy checks.
title: clang-tidy

llmHints.on_match: clang-tidy observed. It exits 0 when checks fire; only --warnings-as-errors=<checks> makes a finding fail the command, so require that flag and the command-run exit code. Findings are text on stdout (no SARIF); -p <build> names the compile_commands.json.

negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
